Near-Surface Monitoring of Stored Carbon Dioxide

The extensive Monitoring, Verification, and Accounting
(MVA) program undertaken for the Illinois Basin - Decatur
Project (IBDP) is being conducted in three phases, pre-,
concurrent, and post-injection. The research-based MVA
program will inform commercial projects underway such
as the Illinois Industrial Carbon Capture and Storage (IL-ICCS)
Project and new projects coming online in the US and globally.

Near-surface and deep subsurface monitoring techniques
are integral to meeting the MVA and project goals of:

1) Establishing pre-injection conditions to evaluate
potential impacts from carbon dioxide (CO2) injection,

2) Demonstrating that project activities are protective of
human health and the environment, and

3) Quantifying pressure changes and tracking stored CO2
in the Mount Simon reservoir.
